Question 8
?

Consider the arc of the curve x=ln⁡y that lies in the first quadrant between its y-intercept and the line y=e. What integral gives the surface area generated when this arc is rotated 2π radians about the x-axis?

a
2π∫2eyy2+1dy
b
2π∫1eyy2+1dy
c
2π∫2ey2+1dy
d
2π∫1ey2+1dy
e
2π∫1ey(y2+1)dy
